findings.title: Existing version2 repeat accepts structural and ACL drift
reproduction: Use qualify_tenant_schema.LocalPostgres with its pinned PostgreSQL16.13 image and random loopback port.
As genui_migration, commit apply_migrations(connection, MIGRATIONS) on a fresh database.
Commit DROP TABLE genui.organization_permissions; then apply_migrations again: accepted.
Commit ALTER TABLE genui.organizations DISABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; then apply_migrations again: accepted.
Commit GRANT UPDATE ON genui.publications TO genui_workspace; then apply_migrations again: accepted.
The latter two observations occurred in the same isolated database after the missing-table mutation; the runner still reported success throughout. No history row or checksum was changed.
Remove the disposable container through LocalPostgres cleanup.
findings.required_disposition: Verify the exact version2 structural/security baseline before successful repeat and after applying; refuse drift without repairing or rewriting it.

findings.title: Preexisting one-row history bypasses version1 baseline verification
reproduction: Use a new LocalPostgres environment and apply the unchanged0001 SQL as genui_migration.
Execute the exact history-table creation and schema_version constraint replacement from runtime.py lines359-365, then insert version1 with INITIAL_MIGRATION_SHA256; commit.
Call apply_migrations(connection, MIGRATIONS) and commit. It succeeds with schema_version2 and retains rolinherit=true for genui_workspace.
findings.required_disposition: Refuse preexisting partial version1 history or verify an explicitly supported complete baseline; history must not bypass role/schema validation.

followups.empty_registry_review: No blocking finding in default empty file creation, explicit-path preservation, owned inode cleanup or existing raw auth handoff. Native interpretation and managed delivery remain separate.

new_findings.title: Database-wide defaults are omitted, allowing effective FK checks to be disabled
reproduction: Use a fresh LocalPostgres instance with pinned PostgreSQL16.13 and apply_migrations to version2.
As the isolated postgres administrator, commit ALTER DATABASE genui SET session_replication_role=replica.
Connect anew as genui_workspace. SHOW session_replication_role returns replica; runtime.verify_schema_catalog(connection,MIGRATIONS) succeeds.
Connect anew as genui_migration. SHOW session_replication_role returns replica; runtime.apply_migrations(connection,MIGRATIONS) succeeds.
Remove the disposable container. No source or managed database was modified.
new_findings.cause: role_database_settings uses an inner join from pg_db_role_setting.setrole to pg_roles; database-wide rows use setrole=0 and vanish. Internal trigger tgenabled facts remain unchanged while replica mode disables origin FK triggers.
new_findings.required_disposition: Include current-database all-role defaults in the canonical projection. Verify effective session_replication_role is origin in migration and native connection admission/reset so a server/operator-session default cannot bypass the baseline. Add actual committed refusal and effective-session regressions without repairing drift.

followups.scope: Final schema/runtime follow-up only; native lifecycle, CI/image and managed acceptance remain separate

checks.scope: Additional independent fresh-database replica-mode refusal before any foundation write
steps: As isolated postgres administrator, GRANT SET ON PARAMETER session_replication_role TO genui_migration.
On a fresh genui_migration connection SET LOCAL session_replication_role=replica; invoke apply_migrations and require runtime.Refused.
Query pg_namespace and pg_roles to confirm no genui foundation schemas or fixed roles were created; SHOW session_replication_role must remain replica.
Rollback the test transaction and remove its disposable container.

followups.r3_disposition: All-role current-database settings are included through a left role join and explicit ALL_ROLES sentinel; effective SET/ALTER SYSTEM parameter privileges for six fixed roles are compared; current origin mode is required before migration writes and catalog verification without SET repair.
followups.empty_registry_disposition: No blocking findings in the retained owned-file implementation; the six focused tests and preexisting auth-file tests passed again on current source.
